# EODHD APIs

EODHD APIs provide comprehensive financial data, including historical stock market data, live stock prices, fundamental data, and more, accessible via REST and WebSocket APIs.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/eodhd-apis/.

## Actions

- **Get Macro Indicators** (read-only): Retrieve macroeconomic indicators data.
- **Get Mutual Funds Data** (read-only): Retrieve mutual funds data for a specified symbol.
- **Get Real-Time FOREX WebSocket Stream** (read-only): Retrieve real-time data for forex via websocket.
- **Get Real-time WebSocket US Trades** (read-only): Retrieve real-time trade data for the us market via websocket.
